---
name: 💡 Request a Feature or Improvement
about: Suggest an enhancement or improvement to the project
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: ["enhancement", "needs-triage"]
assignees: ""
---

## Suggestion

Describe your feature request or improvement idea.

## Problem Statement

Is this addressing a problem? If so, what problem?

## Proposed Solution

How would you like this feature to work?

## Use Cases

Who would benefit from this? When would it be used?

## Alternative Solutions

Have you considered other approaches? What are they?

## Additional Context

- Links to related issues
- Screenshots or mockups
- References or inspiration
- Any other relevant information

## Priority

How important is this improvement?

- [ ] Critical - Blocks other work
- [ ] High - Should be done soon
- [ ] Medium - Nice to have
- [ ] Low - Can be done later

---

**Thank you for your contribution ideas!** 🚀
